correctness.rationale: On each reflexive three-neighbor ring n≥3, Δp = □p∨□¬p gives the local update F(x)i=1 iff the three neighbor bits agree. The only fixed valuation is all one (a fixed one propagates; all zero maps to all one). The five-bit Boolean condition for F²(x)=x is exactly a closed walk in an explicitly defined 16-state de Bruijn transfer graph; the independently computed integer characteristic polynomial is λ^9(λ−1)(λ³−λ−1)(λ³+λ+1). The log-determinant/trace identity yields the exact rational two-cycle GF after subtracting the unique fixed state and dividing by two; the denominator recurrence proves n≥4 except n7 and the simple dominant plastic-root asymptotic ρ^n/2. Separate direct 2^n valuation enumeration for every n=3..12 agreed. No statement about periods>2 is made.
